text: {"lessons":["I made no trades through a substantial account decline; I should review risk and allocation on a schedule rather than let loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate my decisions.","Selling Stock B at gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should use a consistent plan and consider the position’s role in my portfolio.","Past price moves do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and keep decisions grounded in diversification and risk tolerance."]}
